title: Slow Cooker Honey Garlic Chicken Noodles
reject_reason: Sweet-soy braised chicken over noodles is a 4-of-4 structural match to live andong-jjimdak (soy-braised chicken with noodles) and sits in a saturated honey-soy chicken region alongside honey-sesame chicken bowls.
